description: ANEEL - BDGD - EDP - SUBESTAÇÃO is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada que integra a rede da concessionária EDP Brasil (EDP), enviada à Base de Dados Geográfica da Distribuidora (BDGD) da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (ANEEL). Cada feição desta entidade representa a área geográfica que delimita o espaço físico ocupado por uma determinada subestação de interesse. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are ANEEL, BDGD, ELFSM, ENERGIA ELETRICA, es. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
